Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: After an initial search already surfaced the correct record (13-3) and identified the correct team (Rams), the Planner failed to synthesize the available evidence and adapt strategy when Pro-Football-Reference repeatedly timed out. Instead, it kept delegating essentially the same instructions (retrying PFR and similar sources), creating a redundant loop and preventing a timely, conclusive answer. This over-delegation and lack of synthesis—not a factual misread—was the first process error that led the effort away from efficiently delivering the correct solution.
